fields.statement: At 3652345eb ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestOrchestratorConsultsOwner|TestOrchestratorDocRules' -v: both PASS. Read the diff: agents/orchestrator.md 'Consult the owner first' now says consult with a recommendation before any judgment call and act autonomously only when the owner has granted autonomy for that task or session; a new 'When idle' section says propose the next high-value work instead of starting it while queued bug requests still flow through plan-bug/bugfix. grep of AGENTS.md finds no consult/recommendation rule (only the bug-workflow autonomy text). The test checks each phrase and the absence of 'Consult the owner' in AGENTS.md. Note for review: the new 'When idle' heading now sits above the existing 'Quote the owner exactly' and 'Plan a milestone only with the owner' paragraphs, so they read as part of the idle section.
